Labware for the technique (ELISA): 1 finding.
1. WARNING LABWARE-FOR-TECHNIQUE: The wrong kind of plate: Coated ELISA Plate is a PCR plate
  or PCR strips, and ELISA needs a flat plate or a deep-well plate
   line 62:  p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
   The plate map says the technique is ELISA, which needs a flat plate or a deep-well plate
     as its destination. The protocol delivers into Coated ELISA Plate (slot 3, load name
     nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt), which is a PCR plate or PCR strips. A plate
     reader reads a flat, clear-bottomed plate, and an ELISA plate is coated before the
     samples arrive; a PCR plate is neither coated nor readable, and its thin-walled conical
     wells hold little and are meant for a thermocycler. The plate map checks what each well
     holds, not what plate it is.
   Affected: wells A1, A10, A11, A12, A2, A3, A4, A5 and 37 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Load a flat plate (corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat or nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat)
     as the destination: it is what a plate reader reads and what an assay or a culture is
     done in.
   Source: Opentrons, module setup: no error for an unusual labware and module combination
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/modules/setup.html
   Source: Opentrons, thermocycler: takes the 200 ul full-skirt PCR plate
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/modules/thermocycler.html
   Source: ABC-Bench (Liu et al. 2026): wrong labware identifiers, the commonest LLM error
           https://arxiv.org/html/2606.11150v1
   [8a1def997795]

  physics: whether a viscous liquid is pipetted accurately, or a drop stays on a tip.

labware.title: The wrong kind of plate: Coated ELISA Plate is a PCR plate or PCR strips, and ELISA needs a flat plate or a deep-well plate
labware.explanation: The plate map says the technique is ELISA, which needs a flat plate or a deep-well plate as its destination. The protocol delivers into Coated ELISA Plate (slot 3, load name nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt), which is a PCR plate or PCR strips. A plate reader reads a flat, clear-bottomed plate, and an ELISA plate is coated before the samples arrive; a PCR plate is neither coated nor readable, and its thin-walled conical wells hold little and are meant for a thermocycler. The plate map checks what each well holds, not what plate it is.
labware.fix: Load a flat plate (corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat or nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat) as the destination: it is what a plate reader reads and what an assay or a culture is done in.

Opentrons, thermocycler: takes the 200 ul full-skirt PCR plate
ABC-Bench (Liu et al. 2026): wrong labware identifiers, the commonest LLM error

protocol.py: 3 biology problems (2 errors, 1 warning).

1. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: 39 stocks
   line 61:  p300.aspirate(100, src_well)
   At line 61 the tip went into serum 2 (well A2 in slot 1), serum 3 (well A3 in slot 1),
   serum 4 (well A4 in slot 1), serum 5 (well A5 in slot 1) and 35 more while it still
   carried serum 1 (well A1 in slot 1), serum 2 (well A2 in slot 1), serum 3 (well A3 in
   slot 1), serum 4 (well A4 in slot 1) and 35 more from an earlier step (this line did it
   39 times). A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it
   touches, so these stocks now hold material that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from
   them then took the unwanted material along into 44 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6,
   A7, A8, A9 and 36 more in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 31 more in slot 1.
   Also reached 44 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 36 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 61 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194

   Also reached 8 other wells: wells A12, B12, C12, D12, E12, F12, G12 and H12 in slot 3.

wells
   line 71:  p300.dispense(100, dest_well)
